title.narrative: ''Boosting investigative journalism in Ukraine''

description.narrative: To increase the impact and sustainability of independent regional media and citizens access to balanced, factual and reliable information to advance transparency and accountability of local government decision making and spending in Ukraine. Specific objectives are to provide institutional development and financial support to media outlets and watchdog organisations; build the investigative reporting skills via editorial mentoring and thematic support; and facilitate knowledge exchange
